name: Zhai method
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中用于基础结构子系统的显式积分方法。
usage_overview: 用于列车—轨道—下部结构动力分析中的显式逐步积分，求解大规模下部结构响应。在采用集中质量或质量矩阵可对角化的下部结构模型中，可避免每个时间步求解大型线性方程组。

complete_examples.text: The above soil responses are solved by Zhai method based on the lumped mass assumption.
The time step size used in this model is 2 × 10–5 s by explicit Zhai method and the time step size used in the ABAQUS model is 10–3 s by ABAQUS/Explicit Quasi-static solution.
To obtain the responses of the substructure system, explicit method such as Zhai method [41] can be applied.
